label: cull-off-probe
method: CPU ray consistency at stable masked main-component SfM observations, plus position-welded topology. In-sample geometric consistency only, not external ground truth. World scale is approximate.

floor_reference.interpretation: Independent least-squares fit of the near-ground sparse support band. Does not establish measured metric scale.

ray_sample.note: Identical observations reused for baseline and candidates. These points participated in SfM/training; this is consistency, not held-out geometry accuracy.
